Lena (PM): quick design review thread for playground streaming UX. dropped updated frames + a short screen record: https://img.redwood.dev/s/stream-ux.mp4 Omar (Design): got the vid. main questions? Lena (PM): three items: 1) Stop button wording/layout while streaming, 2) token counter behavior when users hit stop mid-stream, 3) keyboard affordance and a11y announcements. Omar (Design): for wording I like a single prominent action 'Stop & Regenerate' during streaming. keeps the primary intent visible. When idle, separate actions are clearer. Priya (Eng): single primary is fine. Implementation note: snapshot token_count at the point of stop and render a small muted label 'paused at 132 tokens'. avoids showing speculative token estimates. Tom (UX): accessibility: add role="status" on completion and aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce the final content only once. also aria-label on the stop control: 'Stop streaming response (Esc)'. Priya (Eng): snippet for engineering:
Response complete stopped at 132 tokens
Omar (Design): microcopy nit: prefer 'Response complete draft saved' rather than 'Stopped' to reassure users. Tom (UX): agree. keyboard: users expect Esc to stop. we use Esc to close panels; solution: composer-scoped Esc stops stream, global Esc still closes. add inline hint 'Press Esc to stop' during stream. Priya (Eng): feasible. will add composer key handler and ensure it doesn't interfere with shortcuts. need to disable prompt library insert while streaming to avoid breaking state. redwood-bot: checklist created: [snapshot token counter, composer-scoped Esc, role=status aria-live, disable prompt inserts, microcopy: 'Response complete draft saved']. Lena (PM): thanks all. Omar, can you produce a compact mobile variant? small screens should show only a single 'Stop' pill and hide regen in overflow at widths < 420px. Omar (Design): will update mocks and post by EOD. Priya (Eng): i'll open a tiny PR for aria attributes + token snapshot tests. ETA tomorrow AM. Tom (UX): i will supply three tone variations for the microcopy and recommend the friendly one. Lena (PM): perfect. leaving thread open for any last nits. :thumbsup:
